description: NativeComfyAPIgraphs used to generate the public demo inputs locally, text-only, no external media. Separate from the app portrait execution workflow. These are API-format graphs, not importable app workflow packs or Comfy frontend canvas format.
installation: See runtime/README.md for pinned Wan runtime and weight hashes. Recasting the supplied demo assets needs only the smaller LivePortrait setup; regenerating these optional inputs needs the larger Wan stack.
execution: POST a chosen graph to your loopback ComfyUI /prompt as {"prompt": GRAPH}; retain prompt_id and retrieve /history/PROMPT_ID then /view output. No auth or provider key is used. Rendering may take minutes. There are no retries or automatic submissions in these data files.
scope: References and driver are fictional synthetic people. Text prompts requested original subjects and did not use a real person reference. No guarantee that synthetic faces are globally unique. The original social trend clip, audio and likeness were not copied.
